name: Nuclear radius
meaning: Radius of a nucleus with A protons plus neutrons, in femtometers (10⁻¹⁵ m).

name: de Broglie wavelength
meaning: Wavelength (m) of a particle of mass m (kg) moving at speed v (m/s); h = 6.626×10⁻³⁴ J·s.

name: Standing-wave condition (de Broglie model)
meaning: A whole number n of electron wavelengths must fit around an allowed orbit of radius r_n; a helpful model, not the full quantum picture.

name: Hydrogen energy levels
meaning: Allowed energies of hydrogen's electron (eV); n = 1 is the ground state, 0 eV means free.

name: Bohr-model orbit radius
meaning: Size of hydrogen's nth state grows as n²; a₀ = 0.0529 nm.

name: Volume per atom in a solid
meaning: Volume each atom occupies, from molar mass M (g/mol), density ρ (g/cm³) and Avogadro's number; its cube root estimates atomic spacing.
